headline: I Am The BRICS Delegate Responsible For Replacing All The Fine China With Unlabeled Tiffin Boxes
body:
When they told me my job for the 2026 BRICS summit was to manage 'geopolitical sensory consistency,' I didn't think it meant physically relocating the entire kitchen inventory. My directive was simple: replace every piece of delicate porcelain with a dented, multi-layered stainless steel tiffin box because the delegates kept confusing their napkins for international trade agreements. 

It started as a minor logistical fix, but by the second day, I had convinced a visiting dignitary that the residual smell of yesterday’s sambhar inside the bottom tier was actually a secret, encrypted communication regarding non-tariff barriers. They were so terrified of offending the local customs that they spent four hours nodding solemnly at a stack of dabbas containing nothing but cold idlis and a single, forgotten rubber band. 

I’ve spent the last 48 hours hiding in the service elevator, sweating profusely as a world leader asks me for the ‘access key’ to the top tier of their lunch container. I told them the latch was a biometric scanner that only recognizes hunger-induced aggression. They’ve been trying to pry it open with a plastic butter knife for an hour, and honestly, this is the most productive diplomatic session we’ve had all year.
caption: Day 3 of the summit and I've successfully convinced the delegation that opening their lunch box in the wrong order triggers a trade war. My career is a mess. #BRICS2026 #Diplomacy #DabbaDiplomacy (satire)
igHook: Tag someone who would try to start an international incident over a lunch box.

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 11 is the most vivid and structurally sound piece. It replaces the common 'nodding intern' trope with a specific, culturally resonant absurd image—the 'dabba' (tiffin) box—and treats the confusion surrounding it with perfect deadpan, avoiding the filler-heavy tendencies of the other candidates.
